summary: Iteration 31 — BACKEND + FRONTEND. All two new backend features (GET /api/gyms/nearby via Google Places, and admin chat pin/clear on /api/chat/{room}/pin & /clear) work as spec'd. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter31_gyms_chatpin.py — 8/8 pass. Frontend UI reorganizations verified via Playwright (mobile 390x844 + desktop 1440x900) logged in as owner (the9hutch@gmail.com). Home tab: open-clans, open-gyms-map, open-diet-health, open-cardio, global-mode-full/-lite present; PR Vault / NEXT WORKOUT / RECAP removed; GYM MAP + DIET & HEALTH cards render ABOVE the CARDIO card (y: 496 < 571 < 646). Clans screen shows clan rows (testID clan-row-*). Profile tab: badges-tab chip present; gender-male/-female + strength-curve + open-gyms-map absent. Diet & Health screen renders CONDITIONING + TODAY'S FUEL, food-add present. Settings has mode-full/mode-lite. Social Hub as admin shows PIN A RULE (chat-pin-btn) + CLEAR CHAT (chat-clear-btn); tapping pin opens pin-input + pin-save modal. Desktop leaderboard (>=1280) DOES render STRENGTH and CARDIO side-by-side (screenshot verified) — but LeaderboardColumn uses testID prefix `col-*` (e.g. col-strength-board-*, col-cardio-act-*), NOT the `leaderboard-column-*` prefix implied by the review request; the split-view feature itself works correctly.
action_items: Optional: if the review contract requires a testID prefix of `leaderboard-column-*` on the desktop STRENGTH/CARDIO panes, add that testID to the outer wrapper in /app/frontend/src/components/LeaderboardColumn.tsx. Today it uses `col-{mode}-board-*` on the inner chips only — the two-pane split renders correctly but there is no `leaderboard-column-strength` / `leaderboard-column-cardio` root testID to select in tests.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/profile.py gyms_nearby: correctly loads GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY from env, uses Places API (New) with X-Goog-FieldMask, clamps radius 200-50000 m, returns {gyms:[], error:'places_unconfigured'} when key missing and {'gyms':[], error:'places_error'} on non-200. Real call to LA returns 20 gyms w/ source='google', name, lat, lng — verified.

routes/chat.py pin/clear: correctly gates on user.get('is_admin') (403 for non-admin). _resolve_store_room reuses the same access rules as messages endpoints (rank gate on the_room, gym→gym:<name>, group membership check). Empty text on set_pin deletes the pin doc. clear_room returns {deleted:N}.
routes/chat.py get_pin returns {pin:null} when doc missing OR text empty — matches spec.
Home tab (index.tsx L233-249): GYM MAP + DIET & HEALTH Pressables are ordered above the CARDIO Pressable in JSX. Verified visually at y=496/571/646.
ChatRoom.tsx L182-190 gates admin buttons on `user?.is_admin && room==='main'` — pin/clear only appear in the main room for admins (matches spec).
